title: The Woman Who Kept Asking
reflectionQuestion: Jesus said to keep talking to God and never give up, because God always loves to listen. I wonder what you would like to keep on talking to God about?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Jesus' Parables, Luke 18:1-8). WATCH-ITEM (Adam): the lesson is 'don't give up TALKING to God', NOT 'wear God down'. Jesus' explanation is explicit: God is NOTHING like the grumpy judge -- 'not to wear God down... but because he loves us, and he loves to listen.' The judge is grumpy/uncaring (mild, comic), God is the loving contrast. Room = keep praying / don't lose heart / God always gladly listens. Parable framed as Jesus telling a story. Soft close ('you'/'always'). VOICE_PRISCILLA_TEACHER (clear, gentle-instructive female -- fits a parable).

scriptureKeyVerse.text: He also spoke a parable to them that they must always pray and not give up,
